overview_description.description: CandorIQ provides a platform that helps organizations manage compensation and workforce planning. The company offers tools that integrate human resources and finance functions, enabling visibility into payroll, headcount, and budget forecasting. Its system uses data-driven insights to assist with merit cycles, churn risk analysis, and workforce scenario modeling. CandorIQ also supports collaboration across teams by consolidating compensation data and automating routine planning tasks.

about_short_description.short_description: CandorIQ provides a platform that helps organizations manage compensation and workforce planning.

product.name: Compensation & Payband Builder
product.description: A tool to create structured job architectures and pay bands for clear role definitions and compensation planning.

product.name: Headcount Scenario Planning
product.description: A platform to plan, forecast, and allocate workforce resources based on organizational needs and budget constraints.

product.name: Headcount Requests & Approvals
product.description: A workflow system to manage, review, and approve headcount requests ensuring alignment with budgets and organizational priorities.

product.name: Workforce Management
product.description: A system to build and manage competitive and fair pay ranges aligned with market data and organizational policies.

product.name: Compensation Cycle
product.description: A platform to run merit and compensation cycles efficiently with AI-driven recommendations for pay adjustments.

product.name: Employee Total Rewards
product.description: A portal that provides employees with transparent access to their total compensation, including salary, benefits, and equity.
